description.fr-FR: Récit de Bossuet sur l’origine et le progrès du quiétisme et sur ses échanges avec Fénelon (Mme Guyon, les conférences d’Issy, le livre des Maximes), suivi de ses remarques sur la réponse de Fénelon. Publié en 1698. Édition Lachat (1864).
description.en-US: Bossuet’s narrative of the origin and progress of Quietism and of his dealings with Fénelon (Madame Guyon, the Issy conferences, the Maxims), followed by his remarks on Fénelon’s reply. Published in 1698. Lachat edition (1864).
description.pt-BR: Relato de Bossuet sobre a origem e o progresso do quietismo e sobre seus tratos com Fénelon (Mme Guyon, as conferências de Issy, o livro das Máximas), seguido de suas observações sobre a resposta de Fénelon. Publicado em 1698. Edição Lachat (1864).

sources.edition: Œuvres complètes de Bossuet, éd. F. Lachat, Paris, Vivès, 1862-1866, in the typed transcription of the Abbaye Saint-Benoît de Port-Valais (Wayback Machine)
sources.description: Typed transcription of volume XX, pages 001-005. The transcription loses the œ ligature; it is restored by a dictionary pass (ambiguous forms such as sœur/sur, mœurs/murs, vœu/vu decided from the Lachat OCR). Page-bottom notes of the Lachat edition are kept as footnotes.
sources.tierEvidence: Bossuet died in 1704; Lachat 1862-66 is public domain.

title.fr-FR: Remarques sur la réponse de M. l’archevêque de Cambrai à la Relation sur le quiétisme
